body:
Closes #117

## Summary

Physical tests on the robot that decide whether the project is complete. All code for the S3 minimum-bit stack (#101–#107) is in place; this PR adds the one piece the robot run needs, S3 loop-timing instrumentation, and absorbs the physical part of #107 (S3-M02 and the line-follow run).

- `LoopTiming` (`robot_time_math.h`) and `loop_timing_report` (`robot_time.h`): the S3 input and Mission tasks print `[TIMING] task=… max_us=… period_us=10000 overruns=… loops=…` every 5 s in every build.
- `testing/subsystem3/TEST_LOG.md`: S3-M02 method defined; new S3-P01 (physical line-follow of the final implementation).
- `testing/mission-readiness.md`: MR-39 places S3-M02 and S3-P01 in the order.

Merge after the robot results are recorded; each measured constant is its own commit on this branch, followed by a rebuild.

## Physical test order (record each in `testing/system/TEST_LOG.md`)

- [ ] **Phase 0, electrical (MR-01..MR-05)** before any power: wiring vs pin table, GP26/GP28 open, Echo ≤ 3.3 V (D05), power polarity, rail voltages under load
- [ ] **Phase 1, boot/safety/MQTT, TEST image, wheels raised (MR-06..MR-11)**: STOP/READY, telemetry every ~500 ms, start refused without a mapping, `map` ACK/BUSY, IMU-missing start refusal
- [ ] **Phase 2, each sensor (MR-12..MR-18)**, recording:
  - [ ] IR raw black/white and calibration (D04): `IR_MIN_CONTRAST`, `IR_WHITE_ENTER/EXIT`, `IR_BROAD_BLACK`
  - [ ] Barcode level: `BARCODE_BLACK_HIGH` (D04)
  - [ ] `ENC_COUNTS_PER_REV`, `*_ENCODER_SIGN` (D03)
  - [ ] IMU pitch sign, tap threshold (D06)
  - [ ] Sonar error at 100/250/500/1000 mm (D05)
  - [ ] `SERVO_CENTRE_US`, `SERVO_US_PER_DEG`, settle time (D05)
- [ ] **S3-M02 (MR-39)**: USB TEST image, at least 60 s over line/white/barcodes; worst `max_us` below 10000 for `s3_input` and `s3_mission`, `overruns=0`
- [ ] **Phase 3, motion calibration, normal image on battery (MR-19..MR-25)**: `LEFT/RIGHT_FORWARD_A`, `WHEEL_DIAMETER_MM`, `TRACK_WIDTH_MM`, `MOTION_KP/KI/KD` (D03/D07), turn errors (with a wheel on a hump too), stopping distance (D08), `MOTION_STALL_MS`
- [ ] **Phase 4, each feature (MR-26..MR-34)**: line loop ×3 under two lightings (M1) **+ S3-P01**; barcodes both directions incl. unmapped/damaged (M2, D01 widths); barcode-before-junction turns (M3, D02 offset); humps (M4/M5, D06); obstacle bypass both sides and blocked (M6–M9); line lost; broker loss; finish marker (`MISSION_FINISH_COUNTS`, D02)
- [ ] **Phase 5, full mission (MR-35..MR-38)**: unfamiliar-letter `map`, full course, three consecutive runs without code/constant changes, route rebuilt from saved `monitor` output

## Test plan

- Host: `testing/pure/run.sh` passes (adds a `LoopTiming` wrap/overrun check).
- Firmware: all four profiles build (offline/wireless × TEST/normal); nothing flashed yet.
- Physical: the checklist above; nothing in this PR is a physical result yet.

commits.messageBody:
LoopTiming records the worst loop-body time and overruns of the S3 input
and Mission tasks; each prints a [TIMING] console line every 5 s in every
build. S3-M02 now has a defined on-target method, S3-P01 defines the
physical line-follow run, and MR-39 places both in the readiness order.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
